recommended_candidate_risks.mitigation: Require explicit confirmation that the contacted person owns or is authorized to approve analysis of the fixed public repository.
A reply is not consent; require the signed intake confirmations before any analysis.
Analyze only public Git history and documentation; do not run the project or request API keys.
Use one human-approved direct or minimally public channel and do not post analysis results publicly.
Use a concise Japanese-or-English message selected by a human and permit no-response closure.

reserve_candidate_risks.mitigation: Keep the evidence boundary to a fixed public commit and finite PR list; never inspect deployment secrets or live services.
Use the reserve only if the recommended candidate is rejected or unavailable and narrow the objective before contact.
